Name: Duckie the duck (horse skin)
Author: NightshadowCat93
Description:
A duck I did for a dear friend of mine as a present, now you can enjoy it, too! This is my first skin from scratch, so please be merciful with me Y A Y
I know the frames are not perfect but eventually we'll fix it together, even you guys if you want! Just let me know if you do!

To use this mod, just download the zipped file, unzip it, take the png file you want to use, go to the "assets" folder of the Adopt and Skin mod, then go to "skins" and create a folder there named "Horse" and just drop or copy/paste your duckie skin there and rename it "Horse_1" to replace your horse's skin with the duck one.

Should work with other mods but not tested yet.

The mod contains:
- two shades of yellow
- two shades of pink
